newsitem.title: USA: Golden Bear, Visa in 5-yr marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Golden Bear, Visa in 5-yr marketing pact.

text.p: -Golden Bear Golf Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a five-year partnership agreement with Visa U.S.A. to start marketing and acceptance programs to promote Visa's exclusive rights as the preferred card of Golden Bear Golf businesses.
The company said that Visa will also integrate Golden Bear Golf Properties and promotions into television advertising and sponsor two televised golf events produced by Jack Nicklaus Productions.

Golden Bear's chairman and largest shareholder is Jack Nicklaus. Its businesses include the Golden Bear Golf Centers, Nicklaus/Flick Golf Schools, several licensed products and other marketing alliances, and the Jack Nicklaus International Golf Club.
Separately, Citibank said Tuesday that it will launch the Citibank Jack Nicklaus Visa Card, which will be offered as a Citibank Platinum Select Card.
